gaps.sentence: Rarely ___ a debut film attracted such wide attention.
gaps.explanation: 'Rarely has a debut film attracted …' — perfect inversion.

gaps.sentence: Seldom have I been so ___ by a performance.
gaps.explanation: 'moved' — the audience was emotionally affected; inversion with have been.

gaps.sentence: Only after the third reminder ___ she reply to my email.
gaps.explanation: 'Only after' fronts the condition, so 'did she reply' inverts.

gaps.sentence: Such ___ the demand for tickets that the website crashed.
gaps.explanation: Such was the demand that… — emphatic result structure.

gaps.sentence: So widespread ___ the outage that servers abroad noticed.
gaps.explanation: So widespread was the outage that… — inversion.

gaps.sentence: ___ it not for your quick thinking, the whole project would have failed.
gaps.explanation: 'Were it not for …' = 'If it were not for …' — formal inverted conditional.

gaps.sentence: Only after the interview ___ I realise how nervous I had been.
gaps.explanation: Only after X did I realise… — inversion.

gaps.sentence: Not once ___ the defendant change his statement.
gaps.explanation: Not once has he changed… — emphatic negative with present perfect.
